mapper.select: SELECT d.id department_id, d.name department_name, SUM(a.status IN ('IN_HOSPITAL','PENDING_DISCHARGE')) current_inpatients, SUM(DATE(a.admission_time) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) admitted_count, SUM(a.status='DISCHARGED' AND DATE(a.discharge_time) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) discharged_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN admission a ON a.department_id=d.id GROUP BY d.id,d.name ORDER BY d.code

SELECT w.id ward_id, w.name ward_name, d.name department_name, COUNT(b.id) total_beds, SUM(b.status='OCCUPIED') occupied_beds, SUM(b.status='AVAILABLE') available_beds, ROUND(SUM(b.status='OCCUPIED') / NULLIF(SUM(b.status IN ('OCCUPIED','AVAILABLE')),0) * 100, 2) utilization_rate FROM ward w JOIN department d ON d.id=w.department_id JOIN room r ON r.ward_id=w.id JOIN bed b ON b.room_id=r.id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND w.active=TRUE AND d.active=TRUE GROUP BY w.id,w.name,d.name ORDER BY d.name,w.name

SELECT d.id department_id, d.name department_name, mi.item_type, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.amount),0),2) revenue FROM department d LEFT JOIN charge_detail c ON c.department_id=d.id AND c.charged_at >= #{from} AND c.charged_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN medical_item mi ON mi.id=c.medical_item_id d.id=#{departmentId} GROUP BY d.id,d.name,mi.item_type ORDER BY d.name,mi.item_type

SELECT mi.id medical_item_id, mi.item_code, mi.name item_name, mi.unit, SUM(CASE WHEN dit.transaction_type IN ('DISPENSE','RETURN') THEN -dit.quantity ELSE 0 END) used_quantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dit.transaction_type='DISPENSE' THEN ABS(dit.quantity) ELSE 0 END),3) dispensed_quantity FROM drug_inventory_transaction dit JOIN medical_item mi ON mi.id=dit.medical_item_id WHERE DATE(dit.created_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY mi.id,mi.item_code,mi.name,mi.unit ORDER BY used_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN a.status='DISCHARGED' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,a.admission_time,a.discharge_time)/24 END),2) average_length_of_stay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_overdue_accounts) overdue_patient_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-available_balance),0) FROM v_overdue_accounts) overdue_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status='DISCHARGED' THEN 1 END) discharged_sample_size FROM admission a WHERE DATE(a.admission_time) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
